what_it_demands: Upper+lower beam headlamp meeting motorcycle photometry; centre 22-54 in (559-1372 mm) above ground; beam indicator; may modulate
bike_part_that_satisfies_it: Full-width LED band in the beak + DRL blade
repo_evidence: Headlamp_installation_STUDY X1392-1482 Z856-896 ground (in range); 'approved optical unit not selected'
gap_and_action: Height OK. Select a DOT-certified LED module (FMVSS 108 self-cert by lamp supplier) that fits the 40 mm band, or widen band; aim/beam pattern untested. A 'light band' styling element cannot be the regulated beam by itself

what_it_demands: Red tail + stop lamp on centreline, 15-72 in (381-1829 mm) high, photometry, stop lamp activated by either brake control (and by regen decel if regen is the service brake)
bike_part_that_satisfies_it: Tail lamp in the tail tip
repo_evidence: Taillamp_installation_STUDY 16x100x20 at Z846-866 ground: reservation only
gap_and_action: Height OK; lamp unit not selected. Stop-lamp trigger from left (rear/regen) lever, right lever AND regen deceleration above 0.7 m/s2 logic to define

what_it_demands: Amber front turn signals, centres >=16 in (406 mm) apart; >=4 in (102 mm) edge-to-edge from the headlamp
bike_part_that_satisfies_it: Front indicator pods under the nose
repo_evidence: Front_indicator_reserve centres at Y+-118 = 236 mm apart; pods sit 2 mm below the headlamp band
gap_and_action: CAD change: move front indicators to Y+-205 min centre (410 mm) on the fairing cheeks or mirror stalks, >=102 mm from the lamp band edge

what_it_demands: Amber or red rear signals, centres >=9 in (229 mm) apart, 15-83 in high
repo_evidence: Rear_indicator_reserve centres 262 mm apart, Z704-726 ground
gap_and_action: Lamp unit not selected; flasher rate 60-120/min and hazard function to specify

what_it_demands: Rear red reflector; side reflectors amber near front, red near rear, 15-60 in high
repo_evidence: Fork_reflector amber on fork legs exists; no rear red or rear-side red reflectors
gap_and_action: Add red rear reflector below tail lamp (X-190, Z700 ground) and red side reflectors on the tail sides (X0..-100, Y+-120, Z700)

what_it_demands: Illuminate the plate
gap_and_action: Unit not selected

what_it_demands: Headlamp on whenever the motorcycle is operating (most states), beam switch, hazard optional
gap_and_action: Electrical schematic for lighting not released

what_it_demands: At least one mirror; flat >=8065 mm2 or convex >=6450 mm2 with R 508-1524 mm; centre >=279 mm outboard; adjustable
repo_evidence: Mirror_glass 114 x 54 mm = 6156 mm2; centre Y 350
gap_and_action: Glass area short (76% of flat minimum). CAD change: glass >=125 x 80 mm (flat, ~9,500 mm2 with R10 corners) or convex R1000 >=110 x 80; head grows to ~150 x 100

what_it_demands: DOT 3/4/5.1/5 fluid meeting boiling point, viscosity etc.; reservoir labelled
repo_evidence: cost-model M-061 brake fluid; no grade fixed
gap_and_action: Specify DOT 4 (ERBP >=230 C) and label reservoirs per FMVSS 122 S5.1.9; fluid supplier certifies

what_it_demands: Hydraulic brake hose assemblies certified, labelled
repo_evidence: Hoses modelled (Nov 12 realism pass); supplier not chosen
gap_and_action: Buy FMVSS 106-labelled assemblies (Brembo/Goodridge/HEL); not in the brief list but mandatory

what_it_demands: DOT-certified motorcycle tyres with load index and speed symbol
gap_and_action: Buy DOT tyres (e.g., 120/70ZR19 60W, 170/60ZR17 72W). 160/60ZR17 69W (325 kg) leaves ~6% margin on the rear GAWR at 487 kg GVWR; 170/60 72W (355 kg) gives 16%

what_it_demands: Tyre load rating >= GAWR; rim size listed for the tyre; rim marked; tyre/rim info on certification label
repo_evidence: Wheels ILLUSTRATIVE; rim widths match ETRTO for 120/70-19 and 160/60-17
gap_and_action: 17x4.50 is listed for 160/60 and narrow-OK for 170/60 (5.00 preferred): pick 17x5.00 if 170/60 chosen. Rim marking (DOT symbol, size, manufacturer, date) on the wheel drawing

what_it_demands: Dry stop single front S<=0.1V+0.0087V2, single rear S<=0.1V+0.0133V2 (60 km/h); all controls S<=0.0060V2 (100 km/h); high speed S<=0.1V+0.0067V2 at 160 km/h; wet; heat fade S2<=1.67S1-0.067V; ABS high/low-mu tests; warning lamps
bike_part_that_satisfies_it: Twin 320 mm discs + radial 4-pot front; 240 mm + 2-pot rear; ABS
repo_evidence: Caliper reserves (Kawasaki candidates); ABS in cost model M-057; no brake sizing study in repo
gap_and_action: Brake sizing study and dyno test. Regen cannot be counted as a service brake unless it is part of the certified system; friction brakes must meet 122 alone with regen off

what_it_demands: Front brake right hand lever; rear brake right foot OR left hand lever on motorcycles with automatic clutch (S5.2.1); twist throttle self-closing; ignition; speedometer (mph); footrests; stand folds rearward/up; Table 3 symbols
bike_part_that_satisfies_it: Left lever 'regen-or-rear'; right lever front brake
repo_evidence: Hand_lever both sides; no side stand, ignition or rear pedal in CAD
gap_and_action: Left lever = rear brake is allowed (no clutch). Add side stand with interlock (no drive with stand down), speedometer mph on the 7-in dash, Table 3 telltales (ABS, high beam, turn, neutral equivalent = 'ready')

what_it_demands: Motorcycle windscreen glazing items AS-4/AS-5/AS-6 rigid plastic, marked
gap_and_action: Specify polycarbonate with hard coat certified AS-4 or AS-6 and marked by the glazing supplier

what_it_demands: Street motorcycles <=80 dBA (test 205 App. I)
bike_part_that_satisfies_it: Silent EV drive; belt and gear whine only
gap_and_action: Confirm EPA applicability to battery-electric motorcycles in writing; an EV will be far under 80 dBA either way. No US minimum-sound rule: FMVSS 141 excludes motorcycles

what_it_demands: Certificates of conformity for ICE motorcycles
gap_and_action: Battery-electric: no exhaust or evap certification. CARB may still request a zero-emission statement for California registration

what_it_demands: 17-character VIN with check digit; WMI from SAE; on frame
gap_and_action: Request WMI (small manufacturer, '9' in position 3 rules) from SAE; reserve a stamped VIN pad on the head tube (right side, X1180 Y+35 Z890 ground)

what_it_demands: Submit name, address, vehicle types to NHTSA no later than 30 days after manufacturing starts
gap_and_action: File Part 566 (and Part 551 agent if foreign)

what_it_demands: Permanent label: manufacturer, month/year, GVWR, GAWR front/rear, VIN, 'conforms to all applicable FMVSS', type MC; on the steering head or frame
gap_and_action: Reserve a 75 x 50 mm label pad on the frame right side near the head tube (X1120, Y-170, Z860 ground). Set GVWR (proposal 487 kg) and GAWRs

what_it_demands: Recall process; TREAD early-warning reporting (reduced for <5,000/yr)
gap_and_action: Set up before first sale

what_it_demands: Lithium battery shipped alone (UN3480) or vehicle (UN3171) needs UN 38.3 test summary
gap_and_action: Run UN 38.3 at pack level (large battery) - see EU-15

what_it_demands: Unintentional radiators; intentional radiators (Bluetooth/LTE key) need certification
gap_and_action: Use pre-certified radio modules; verify Part 15B emissions on vehicle

clause_or_topic: Pack and charger (voluntary in law; expected by insurers and dealers)
what_it_demands: UL 2271 battery safety for light EVs; UL 2202 charging equipment; NACS (J3400) inlet
gap_and_action: Plan UL 2271-style pack test set alongside R136; OBC supplier UL listing

clause_or_topic: Category L3e-A3 and type approval route
what_it_demands: Whole-vehicle type approval; A3 = >35 kW (motorcycle, no power cap); technical service + approval authority; CoP
gap_and_action: Choose a technical service (e.g., TUV, IDIADA, UTAC) and an approval authority; COP audit of the plant

what_it_demands: Headlamp, position, stop, direction indicators, rear reflector, plate lamp; front indicators inner edges >=240 mm apart; rear >=180 mm (R53 6.3) and positioning angles
gap_and_action: Front indicator spacing ~208 mm inner edge (fails 240); fixed by the US-03 move. Geometric visibility angles to check in CAD

what_it_demands: E-marked signalling lamps (R148) and headlamps (R149) and retro-reflectors (R150)
gap_and_action: Buy E-marked units; a single unit can carry both DOT and E marks

what_it_demands: Two mirrors (L3); each surface must contain a 78 mm circle and fit in 120 x 200 mm, or be >=94 mm round; R 1000-1500 mm convex class L
gap_and_action: 54 mm height cannot hold a 78 mm circle: grow the glass to >=125 x 80 (same change as US-08)

what_it_demands: Control locations/identification (brake levers, throttle, horn, lights, indicators); symbols
gap_and_action: Same as US-14; R60 allows the rear brake on the left lever for no-clutch vehicles

what_it_demands: Dry stop, high speed, wet, heat fade, ABS mandatory on L3e >125 cc equiv (all L3e-A3); regenerative braking provisions (R78 Annex 3 'regenerative braking' categories)
gap_and_action: R78 tests mirror FMVSS 122 (both from GTR 3): run one combined campaign. Declare regen as category A or B per R78 and test with and without regen

what_it_demands: E-marked horn
repo_evidence: Switch cube lists horn; no horn body
gap_and_action: Add horn (e.g., 105-118 dB(A) R28 class I) behind the nose, X1350 Y0 Z650 ground, facing forward, splash-shielded

what_it_demands: E-marked tyres
gap_and_action: Buy E-marked tyres

clause_or_topic: Electrical safety - protection against electric shock
what_it_demands: IPXXD inside passenger/luggage area, IPXXB elsewhere; HV marking; isolation >=100 ohm/V DC (>=500 ohm/V AC buses); charging coupler >=1 Mohm disconnected; potential equalisation; water ingress test with isolation maintained (5.1.2.4.2 / Annex 9B)
bike_part_that_satisfies_it: HV cabinet, pack, cables, OBC, inlet
repo_evidence: HV_cabinet_2mm_STUDY 'seals, interlock unresolved'; insulation monitor listed as needed in electrical-design.md
gap_and_action: Isolation monitor, HVIL, orange cables, IPXXB covers, bonding straps to frame; washing/wading test

what_it_demands: No leakage/rupture/fire/explosion; isolation >=100 ohm/V after test
gap_and_action: Pack-level test on rig

what_it_demands: As above
gap_and_action: Chamber test

clause_or_topic: REESS mechanical shock for vehicles with side/centre stand (Annex 8D: stationary fall-down)
what_it_demands: No leakage/rupture/fire/explosion, REESS retained, isolation >=100 ohm/V after the vehicle falls from its stand
repo_evidence: As CAD the bike lands on the lever tip, peg bracket and the 3 mm belly cover; pack edge 8 mm above ground
status: FAIL as CAD / PASS by calc with guards
gap_and_action: Add guards (CR-1..CR-4). With guards the pack is 70 mm off the ground at rest. Exact Annex 8D parameters to confirm from the consolidated UNECE text

what_it_demands: Only if the pack is removable by the user
gap_and_action: Pack is not user-removable; declare so

clause_or_topic: Fire resistance (only with passenger compartment: N/A), external short, overcharge, over-discharge, over-temperature, over-current protection
what_it_demands: No fire or explosion and isolation >=100 ohm/V after each abuse; protection device must interrupt or limit the fault
gap_and_action: Protection functions and tests at pack level; fire test N/A for motorcycles without a passenger compartment

regulation: UN Manual of Tests and Criteria 38.3
clause_or_topic: T1 altitude, T2 thermal, T3 vibration, T4 shock (large battery: 50 gn or sqrt(30000/m) = 15 gn for 134 kg, 11 ms), T5 external short, T6 impact/crush (cell), T7 overcharge, T8 forced discharge (cell)
what_it_demands: Pass all applicable tests before any pack or bike is shipped (air/sea/road); test summary available to shippers
gap_and_action: Cell 38.3 from the cell maker; pack-level T1-T5 and T7 at a lab. Case side walls need internal webs <=150 mm apart to carry 15 gn (calc)

regulation: ISO 18243 / ISO 13063-1/-2/-3 (IEC 62133 and ISO 6469 named in the brief)
clause_or_topic: Battery system and vehicle electrical safety (L-category versions)
what_it_demands: Motorcycle-specific battery (ISO 18243) and electrical-safety (ISO 13063) test methods; IEC 62133-2 is for portable cells and ISO 6469 for cars, so they are references only; IEC 62660-1/-2/-3 covers traction cells
gap_and_action: Use ISO 18243 + IEC 62660 as the test basis for the pack/cell; cite 62133/6469 only where the supplier certifies to them

what_it_demands: Vehicle emissions (broadband/narrowband), immunity 30 V/m (or 1 V/m path); RESS charging mode tests (conducted harmonics, flicker, surges) for vehicles charging from the grid
gap_and_action: Vehicle EMC chamber in drive and charge mode; ESA approvals for the OBC

regulation: Delegated Reg (EU) 134/2014 Annex IX + UN R41
what_it_demands: R41 drive-by limits for L3e; electric L3e: AVAS is optional (if fitted, must meet the annex)
gap_and_action: Drive-by test with the R41 method adapted for EV; decide AVAS (recommended off for the A3 launch, revisit)

clause_or_topic: Max continuous rated power / torque declaration
what_it_demands: 30-min power for electric drives; feeds A3 category and the CoC
repo_evidence: drive-study.md: IPM 130 kW peak spec envelope
gap_and_action: Bench test of the motor/inverter on a dyno (R85 method)

what_it_demands: WMTC-based range and Wh/km for the CoC/marketing
gap_and_action: Chassis dyno WMTC test

clause_or_topic: Stands, passenger handholds and footrests, statutory plate and VIN, registration plate space, tamper protection
what_it_demands: Stand must hold the bike on slopes and fold away; passenger handholds/footrests if a passenger seat is declared; statutory plate and VIN location; EU plate space
repo_evidence: Plate envelope exists; no side stand; rack 'load rating unresolved'; no passenger pegs
gap_and_action: Add side stand (prefer also a centre stand for touring), passenger pegs and handholds if two-up is declared, statutory plate next to VIN. EU plate space differs from the US 7x4 in envelope

what_it_demands: Carbon-footprint declaration, battery passport (Feb 2027), labelling, due diligence, recycled-content and removal for recycling
gap_and_action: Supplier data chain for cells; QR label; passport data system

what_it_demands: Yellow triangle HV symbol on REESS and barriers
gap_and_action: Add HV labels to pack lid and cabinet

clause_or_topic: Functional safety of the electronic throttle and regen
what_it_demands: Throttle return, fault response; ISO 26262-style analysis expected by the technical service
gap_and_action: Hazard analysis + FMEA; test of throttle and regen faults

what_it_demands: >=200 mm static laden; breakover >=28 deg
gap_and_action: Full-bump clearance at the skid ~77 mm; breakover 32 deg for a flat skid

bike_part_that_satisfies_it: Pack, HV cabinet, motor, gear case, connectors
repo_evidence: drive-study.md asks IP67 for the low cabinet
gap_and_action: IP67 specification and vent/breather routing (CR-7). Hot-pack-into-cold-water suction to be covered by a pressure-equalisation vent

what_it_demands: No pack, radiator, lever or HV contact in a standstill tip-over; parts replaceable after a 50 km/h low-side
repo_evidence: None in CAD; pack case notes 'crash qualification NOT done'
gap_and_action: CR-1..CR-5

what_it_demands: 3 g bottom-out on a 50 mm rock: no contact with the pack floor
gap_and_action: 6 mm 5083-H321 skid, extended rearward (CR-6), floor crush zone
